headline: STL @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is STL 3.61 at MIL 4.32, with a projected total of 7.92. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: STL moved +0.03 runs while MIL moved +0.39, changing the projected margin by -0.36 runs. The projected total climbed +0.42, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -12.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Kyle Harrison has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jake Bauers, William Contreras, Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Blake Perkins because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
